_: The authored half of the lapis (Monitoring) public record: cases written family by family, each carrying its declared nature and a one-sentence reason. No real transaction and no real person: every account, amount and date here was written for the archetype it illustrates. The set earns its keep through the benign look-alikes: each benign nature is the twin of a suspicious one (payroll of rapid-movement, seasonal-trade of dormant-burst, loan-repayment of round-tripping, rent-collection of structuring, savings-transfer of rapid-movement, one-off-purchase of the raw amount peak), separated by history and rhythm, which is exactly what the relative scenarios must see. Validated case by case with exigerCas at authoring time; the suite revalidates.
